subject: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@echotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms

Hi Maya —

Thanks for confirming Friday as the target for the console walkthrough and API enablement. A few quick notes and a proposal so we can lock the calendar:

1) Goal: 2-hour kickoff with a single 60-min console walkthrough (product + admin controls) and a concurrent 60-min API hands-on lab. We plan to run the API lab as a smaller hands-on cohort (max 6 engineers) while the rest observe.

2) Breakouts: to keep the console audience engaged we suggest a short breakout at the 45-minute mark where engineers can join the lab (if seats free). We can also provide a recording and the runbook.

3) Logistics ask from Echo: correct me if I’m wrong — you’ll have 6 engineers for the API lab, two product admins, and one security reviewer joining live. Please confirm time zone constraints for the security reviewer (EMEA overlap).

Proposed windows (pick one):
- Option A: Fri Jul 21, 2028 09:00–11:00 PT (best for Redwood east coast coverage)
- Option B: Fri Jul 21, 2028 13:00–15:00 PT (better for EMEA overlap at end of day)

I’ve attached a draft agenda and the API prep checklist. If those windows don’t work we can slide to Mon Jul 24 — I want to avoid repeating config steps if we can.

Next steps: please confirm preferred slot, attendee list, and whether you want the API lab to include live token/key generation (we can provide temporary creds scoped to sandbox).

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Echo-Onboard-Agenda.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)
Attachment: API-Prep-Checklist.md (text)
From: Maya Singh <maya@echotech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: EchoTech Onboarding <onboarding@echotech.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear options. Option B (13:00–15:00 PT on Jul 21) works best for most of the team — our security reviewer (Ravi Kumar, based in London) will join the first hour, then drop off. Confirming attendee count: 6 engineers, 2 product admins (Priya & Sam), Ravi (security), and myself.

Two asks:
- Can the API lab include a short section on rate limiting and cost profiling? Our infra lead specifically asked.
- We need a breakout link for the lab (separate Zoom room) and a meeting dial-in (we’ll add to our calendar invite).

We’re OK with temporary sandbox creds. Also can you confirm whether SSO is required for the console demo (we have SAML set up but prefer a local admin account for the live demo).

Appreciate it — I’ll hold the slot tentatively until you confirm.

Best,
Maya
Director of Engineering | EchoTech
maya@echotech.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@echotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms

Maya —

Great — Option B is locked from our side. Quick answers:
- API lab plan: we’ll add a 10-minute segment on rate limiting + cost profiling using your typical traffic shape. Ben will run that segment and share our Optimize suggestions.
- Zoom rooms: we’ll create two rooms and drop links into the calendar invite (console main room + API lab breakout).
- SSO: no, SSO isn’t required for the demo. Recommend we use a local admin account for the live console walkthrough to avoid SAML delays; we’ll also show the SSO flow in the admin settings briefly.

I’ll send a calendar invite with both Zoom links and the shared Drive folder. Please confirm if you prefer a separate Slack channel for real-time ops during the session — our on-call engineer can lurk there for faster troubleshooting.

Quick ask for Ravi: if he can join from 13:00–14:00 PT that would be ideal.

Thanks,
--
Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@echotech.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms

Folks —

I built a tiny sandbox runner and test creds that will expire after 48 hours. For the lab we’ll:
- Pre-seed a sample dataset (user prompts + KV cache patterns)
- Show two quantization profiles and their perf/cost tradeoffs
- Walk through a quick failover demo to a lower-cost variant

I’ll attach the script and the temp keys in the Drive folder and coordinate with your infra lead on network egress rules.

Attachment: API-Prep-Script.sh (shell)
From: Maya Singh <maya@echotech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: EchoTech Onboarding <onboarding@echotech.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Echo onboarding — split-track plan + breakout rooms

Thanks everyone — confirmed Jul 21, 2028 13:00–15:00 PT. We’ve added the calendar invite and included Ravi (ravi.kumar@echotech.com) for the first hour. We prefer Slack for real-time comms — creating #echo-redwood now and will invite Ben/Evelyn.

One small request: could you add a one-slide summary of the failover demo to the agenda so our product manager can prep questions? Otherwise we’re good.

See you next week.

Best,
Maya
